Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 15  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Oz the Great and Powerful was released first" based on its world premiere date of February 13, 2013, while ignoring that "Sacred Planet" had an earlier confirmed release date of April 22, 2004. The Planner failed to correctly compare the release dates of the two films, as the 2004 release of "Sacred Planet" clearly precedes the 2013 release of "Oz the Great and Powerful." This misinterpretation of the data led directly to the incorrect final answer.
